known_gaps: The frozen 500-PR capture contains no review or filtered-timeline connection requiring more than one page, so multi-page transport behavior remains synthetic.
The source panel contains individual PRs with no review objects but no repository selected for having no review activity at all.

The same observed Census informed the product direction and these coverage buckets; no accuracy, prevalence, time-saving, safety, retention, or market claim may use this regression set as independent evidence.

selection.selection_note: Buckets are assigned in the frozen order, so a case selected for an earlier bucket cannot be selected again. Rewrite-heavy takes one post-force-push case per named repository, preferring a same-reviewer completed re-review before hash rank. Stable cases first cover repositories not yet represented, then fill by hash rank. Outcomes informed every bucket; this is regression coverage, not a holdout.
